steps: plane — daddy (a: /eɪ/ — /æ/); time — picture (i: /aɪ/ — /ɪ/); excuse — hungry (u: /juː/ — /ʌ/); these — September (e: /iː/ — /e/); phone — hobby (o: /əʊ/ — /ɒ/); my — gymnast (y: /aɪ/ — /ɪ/).

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. c, с. 9. 1) Запиши, откуда прибыли товары на картинках. 2) Расскажи о продуктах из твоей страны.
steps: 1) These sausages come from Poland. They're Polish sausages. These biscuits come from the USA. They're American biscuits. This butter comes from England. It's English butter.
2) Tvorog comes from Russia. It's Russian tvorog.
problems.answer: … comes from … It's … (Polish sausages, American biscuits, English butter, Russian tvorog)

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. d, с. 9. 1) Прочитай текст и найди Эми и Роба на картинке. 2) Проверь себя по с. 28.
steps: Amy and Rob — children 3 and 5.
problems.answer: Children 3 and 5.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. e, с. 10. 1) Предположи, как выглядит мистер Биг. 2) Опиши его — одноклассник рисует. 3) Сравните рисунки.
steps: Mr Big is tall and fat. He's got short dark hair and small eyes. He's wearing a black coat and a hat.
problems.answer: Описание: He is tall / short. He's got … hair and … eyes. He's wearing …

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. f, с. 11. 1) Прослушай, отметь верные слова в таблице и найди Лизу и Алекса. 2) Запиши описание Лизы и Алекса.
steps: Lisa's got a tall, thin body. Her hair is long and fair. She's wearing a skirt and a jacket. She's got glasses.
Alex's got a tall body. His hair is short and dark. He's wearing a T-shirt, trousers and a hat.
problems.answer: Lisa — tall, thin, long fair hair, skirt, jacket, glasses. Alex — tall, short dark hair, T-shirt, trousers, hat.

problems.condition: Unit 2, Odd one out, с. 11. Вычеркни лишнее слово.
steps: Spanish — национальность, остальные — названия стран.
problems.answer: Spanish

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. a, с. 12. 1) Найди ошибки в компьютерных портретах. 2) Скопируй неверные части и напиши, кто это.
steps: 1) The mouth is wrong — Sue hasn't got a small mouth. The hair is wrong — Les hasn't got black hair. The eyes are wrong — Liz hasn't got small eyes.
2) It is Zak.
problems.answer: 1) mouth, hair, eyes. 2) Zak

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. b, с. 13. Напиши, что делают люди на картинках (профессии).
steps: Dot Roc is a doctor. She looks after sick people. Netti Ciss is a scientist. She works in a laboratory. Reg Genie is an engineer. He designs cars. Ted Device and Even Better are detectives. They catch criminals. Tara Stoun is an astronaut. She goes to the Moon.
problems.answer: doctor — looks after sick people; scientist — works in a laboratory; engineer — designs cars; detectives — catch criminals; astronaut — goes to the Moon

problems.condition: Unit 3, Odd one out, с. 13. Найди лишнее слово.
steps: laboratory — место, остальные — профессии.
problems.answer: laboratory

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. c, с. 14. 1) Заполни карточку № 1. 2) Заполни карточку № 2.
steps: 1) Favourite subjects: Russian, English, Art. I am friendly. 2) I like animals, music, plants and books.
problems.answer: Карточки о себе: любимые предметы, характер, что нравится.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. d, с. 15. Заполни предложения глаголами в настоящем времени.
steps: like, is, catches, has got, is, are, help.
problems.answer: like, is, catches, has got, is, are, help

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. e, с. 15. Представь себя детективом и задай вопросы о мистере Биге.
steps: Who is Mr Big? Why is he in London? What does he want? Where is he now?
problems.answer: Who, Why, What, Where

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. f, с. 15. Напиши вопросы о Джозефе Александере, уточняя информацию.
steps: Does Joseph Alexander live in the USA? Is his birthday on 10 January? Has he got green eyes and red hair? Is he an explorer? Can he help Professor Wallace?
problems.answer: Does he live…? Is his birthday…? Has he got…? Is he an explorer? Can he help…?

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. a, с. 16. 1) Найди различия между картинками. 2) Составь предложения об отличиях.
steps: The birds were on the tent, now they are on the ground. The girl was behind the tree, now she is behind the tent. The bags were on the ground, now they are on the table. There was one porcupine, now there are two. The monkey was in the tree, now it is under the table.
problems.answer: … was / were …, now … is / are …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. b, с. 17. 1) Соедини людей со странами и родом деятельности. 2) Составь предложения по образцу.
steps: Brunel — engineer — Britain; Columbus — explorer — Italy; Marie Curie — scientist — Poland; Cleopatra — queen — Egypt; Pablo Picasso — painter — Spain; the Wright brothers — pilots — USA.
Columbus was an Italian explorer. Marie Curie was a Polish scientist. Cleopatra was an Egyptian queen. Picasso was a Spanish painter. The Wright brothers were American pilots.
problems.answer: Brunel — British engineer, Columbus — Italian explorer, Curie — Polish scientist, Cleopatra — Egyptian queen, Picasso — Spanish painter, Wright brothers — American pilots

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. c, с. 18. 1) Прослушай запись и заполни таблицу (что умеют животные). 2) Напиши о двух животных по образцу.
steps: 1) porcupine — can run backwards; platypus — can lay eggs; pelican — can lay eggs; tree frog — can lay eggs and climb trees.
2) A pelican can lay eggs, but it can't run backwards, climb trees or smile. A tree frog can lay eggs and climb trees, but it can't run backwards or smile.
problems.answer: … can …, but it can't …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. d, с. 18. 1) Найди слова, которые не похожи по звучанию на остальные. 2) Проверь по аудиозаписи.

problems.answer: catch criminals / detective; she / she; does / is; Does he design…? Is he an engineer?

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. f, с. 19. 1) Составь вопросы по образцу (о прошлом годе). 2) Задай их другу и расскажи, что изменилось.
steps: 1) How tall were you last year? What was your favourite book last year? What was your favourite lesson last year?
2) Last year my friend was 9, now she's 10. Last year she was 137 cm, now she's 140. Last year her favourite lesson was Maths, now it's Music.
problems.answer: How tall were you…? What was your favourite …? — Last year …, now …

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. a, с. 20. 1) Скажи, откуда взялись предметы на картинках. 2) Проверь по аудиозаписи. 3) Напиши ещё о пяти предметах. 4) Какие продукты производятся в твоей стране?
steps: 1) Paper, wood, orchids, bananas, pineapples come from the forest. Oil, salt, gas, fish come from the sea. Metal, oil, salt, jewels come from under the ground.
3) Fish come from the sea. Jewels come from under the ground. Pineapples come from the forest. Salt comes from the sea. Metal comes from under the ground.
4) A: Which things come from Russia? — B: Oil, gas, salt, wood and fish.
problems.answer: forest — paper, wood, fruit; sea — fish, salt; under the ground — metal, oil, gas, jewels

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. b, с. 20. Разбери правила чтения буквосочетания ch и прочитай слова.
steps: /tʃ/: change, channel, cheese, China, Chinese. /ʃ/: chef. /k/: chemist's, Christmas.
problems.answer: ch = /tʃ/ (cheese, China), /ʃ/ (chef), /k/ (chemist's, Christmas)

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. c, с. 21. Прочитай шуточные вопросы и ответь на них.
steps: There are spiders that eat birds. There are insects that eat horses. There are fish that eat animals. There are birds that eat monkeys.
problems.answer: There are spiders that eat birds, insects that eat horses, fish that eat animals, birds that eat monkeys.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. d, с. 21. Посмотри на картинки и опиши их.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. f, с. 22. 1) Выучи новые слова по картинкам. 2) Расставь части инструкции о выращивании подсолнуха по порядку.

2) Put the seed in a pot with compost. Put the pot on a plate and water the seed. Cover the pot with a plastic bag. Put it in a warm place. When the plant grows, take the bag off.
problems.answer: seed → pot with compost → water → plastic bag → warm place → take the bag off

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. h, с. 23. Найди на рисунках достопримечательности Москвы и дополни предложения о высоте.
steps: How tall is Ivan the Great Bell Tower? — 81 metres. Moscow University? — 240 metres. The TV Tower? — 536 metres. The Motherland statue? — 85 metres.

A snake is from Africa. It lives in the desert. It has got no legs. It can crawl. I don't like it.
problems.answer: Карточки: name, from, lives, legs, tail, can — о двух животных.

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. f, с. 26. Впиши в таблицу названия времён года и месяцев.

Только одна страна — на континенте Australia.
problems.answer: Таблица континент — страна — животные; Australia — один континент = одна страна
